Name: Elemental Spirits
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
This was one of the naver mods I found that I was able to obtain permission for from the author, Roam. Elemental Spirits for your farm!

This mod adds 4 different types of elemental spirits to Marnie's shop:

-Earth Spirit: produces earth crystals and omni geodes
-Water Spirit: produces frozen tears and frozen geodes
-Fire Spirit: produces fire quartz and magma geodes
-Wind Spirit: produces duck feathers and quartz

The spirits live in barns and can be purchased for 10,000g

Enjoy!
